hook.line: If you're job searching, find jobs the same way recruiters find candidates.
hook.visual: Big yellow 'How to Find Hidden Jobs' title over her face; at 0.38 s she jumps onto a crying-at-laptop meme background as a green-screen cutaway.

beats.what: Title 'How to Find Hidden Jobs' and the recruiter-flip promise; meme background behind her.
Credibility: 'as a recruiter'; search-box screenshot on the top half, face below.
Back to full face: hidden jobs you won't see on LinkedIn or Indeed.
Step 1: pick an ATS; ATS logo stickers pop in beside her.
Step 2: Google screen recording typing 'site:' on the top half.
Step 3: worked example, typing the quoted job titles and 'remote'.
Result: a real Google list of remote recruiting coordinator roles.
Contrast: faded LinkedIn jobs page over her face, what you'd normally see.
Tip: start simple and iterate, with a 'Simple' label and the query chip.
Reframe line and follow ask to close.

why_it_works: Insider flip ('use the recruiter's own trick') gives a reason to trust and a secret to learn in one line.
Every instruction is shown typed into Google on the top half while she talks below, so it can be copied step by step.
The actual search results at 38 s prove it works before the tips, rewarding viewers who stayed.
Logo stickers and a meme cutaway break up a mostly static selfie shot every few seconds.
weaknesses: Small captions in the lower middle; 79% of text sits outside the safe zone.
The full query is only in the post caption, never shown whole on screen.
Hand-held mic in frame at all times adds clutter.
for_robert: Use the top half for the real screen and keep your face below it; Fred can tap the typed query on the screen half as you say each step.
